sheetTitle: Send the trip to the driver
sheetText: The driver opens this link on the phone — no app, no login. It shows the route on the map, the stops with times and what to drop where.
noLink: No driver link yet for this trip.
turnOffText: The driver will no longer see this trip.
whatsapp: Spareway trip {{code}} — your route, stops and times: {{link}}
noRoute: Route not chosen yet — straight line between stops
endedText: Ask the owner for a new driver link.
avoidChallan: Papers and fines — avoid a challan
navStartHelp: Live map on the truck route — turns, time, speed, tolls

nav.title: Spareway drive
nav.intro: Live map that follows your truck on the route your owner planned for trucks — it avoids no-entry hours and truck-banned roads, and knows the tolls and rest stops.

points.p1: Big next-turn arrow and spoken directions in your language
points.p2: Arrival time and km left to the next stop
points.p3: Speed warning above the truck limit — avoid challans
points.p4: Warns you when you leave the truck route

nav.privacy: While this screen is open your location is shared with {{company}} so they can see the truck. It stops when you close it.
nav.simulated: Demo drive — Simulated, not your real location

gps.denied: Location is blocked. Allow location for this site in the phone settings, or
gps.unavailable: No GPS signal yet. Move to open sky, or

nav.off: Off the truck route — go back to the green road ({{dist}})
nav.offSay: You have left the truck route. Please go back to the planned road.
nav.slowDownSay: Please slow down. The truck limit is {{limit}} kilometres per hour.
nav.sharing: Location shared with the owner · accuracy {{m}} m

weigh.buttonHelp: Type the slip weight — it proves the load to the owner
weigh.title: Weighbridge reading
weigh.text: Type the full truck weight from the weighbridge slip. Your phone location is saved with it.
weigh.grossError: Type the gross weight from the slip
weigh.tareHelp: Leave empty if it is not on the slip — the truck record is used
weigh.tareError: Empty weight must be less than the full weight
weigh.mismatch: Saved — {{net}} weighed, {{declared}} on the list. Owner told.
